@Sofia, here are the bullets for June on the PHL label confusion. I haven't sent anything to June. Copy these into your note, or tell me if you want me to DM them to her.

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb 2026. The old code was CLR and the new code is PHL.
- PHL is also the code for Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast terminal), so filtering on "PHL" returns both businesses. Use the full name when filing tickets or building views.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". It needs relabelling to Pellow Home Living so supervisors stop searching under the old name.
